stock.description: Operating across the People's Republic of China and Sudan, Jiangsu Innovative Ecological New Materials Limited is dedicated to the research, production, and sale of specialized oil refining agents and fuel additives. The company was established in 2002 and maintains its primary corporate office in Yixing, located within the PRC. It operates as a subsidiary under the ownership of Innovative Green Holdings Limited.
